3 things I learned from selling digital products that I wish I knew when I first started. 💻 ✨ 1. Your product needs to solve a problem. One of the biggest mistakes beginners make is creating products simply because they think they look good or because everyone else is selling them. But think about it: people are more likely to purchase something when they can see how it helps them. Your eBook, template, guide, or digital download should solve a problem, answer a question, save someone time, or help them achieve a specific goal. Before choosing a product, ask yourself: What does this help someone accomplish? Who would benefit from it? Why would they need it? ✨ 2. Your audience needs to understand the value. You can have an amazing product, but if your audience doesn’t understand what they’re getting out of it, they won’t have much reason to buy. Don’t just post a picture of your eBook and say, “Link in bio.” Show people what’s inside, explain what they’ll learn, highlight the problems it addresses, and demonstrate how it could make their lives easier. Stop focusing only on selling the product and start communicating the benefits. People need to understand why your offer is worth their investment. ✨ 3. Marketing matters just as much as creating. This is probably one of the biggest lessons I’ve learned. Creating a digital product is only one part of running an online business. You also have to learn how to get people to see it! That means creating engaging content, understanding your target audience, using attention-grabbing hooks, building trust, and having clear calls to action. You cannot expect people to purchase something they don’t know exists. Your marketing is what connects your product to the people who need it. Here’s what I want you to remember: You don’t need 20 different digital products to start building an online business. Start with one valuable product, understand who you’re selling to, and learn how to market it effectively. Consistency, patience, and a willingness to improve will take you much further than constantly creating new products without a strategy. 💕 If you’re ready to learn the process instead of figuring everything out through trial and error, grab my digital marketing eBook through the ⛓️‍💥 in my by0!
